verdict.rationale: Mollie documents HMAC-signed webhooks, a next-gen subscription model with a Webhook Events API for retroactive inspection of past events, and idempotency keys to prevent duplicate processing on retries. However, there is no explicit documentation of automatic delivery retry policies/backoff for failed webhook deliveries, nor an explicit 'replay' mechanism to resend a webhook to trigger reprocessing (only retrieval/inspection of past events is shown). missing for 10: documented automatic retry/backoff schedule for failed webhook deliveries, explicit replay-to-resend capability, independent/hands-on corroboration of reliability in production.
